name: Spider Climb

components.m: a drop of bitumen and a spider

summary: A willing creature can climb walls and ceilings hands-free and gains a Climb Speed equal to its Speed.
text: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch can move up, down and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings while leaving its hands free, and it gains a Climb Speed equal to its Speed. You can target one more creature for each spell slot level above 2.
